summary: Remove interface/newmaps; the map dialog draws only from the map kit
author: pm
body:
The user, 2026-11-25, on `staged/client/sprites/interface/newmaps`: "These can also be removed as we have replaced them with the map kit".

| fact | value |
|---|---|
| loader | `screen_loading.cpp:155-160` loads sprites 0-4 as InterfaceNewMaps1-5 (as of 2026-11-25) |
| ids | `sprite_id.h:13-17` |
| only use | `dialog_box_map.cpp:20-39`: the legacy_frames table, a fallback for maps the parchment kit lacks (aresden, elvine, middleland, default, huntzone1-4, arefarm, elvfarm). All 10 maps have mapkit folders (located) |

**Done when:** the legacy fallback is removed (the map dialog opens only for maps in the kit), the newmaps load and ids are gone, the folder is archived byte-identical to working/archive/interface/newmaps/ and git rm'd, and both builds are clean.

Source: user message, 2026-11-25. `screen_loading.cpp` and `sprite_id.h` are shared with HH-0101 and HH-0103 and are waiting on HH-0090's guard.

**Landed, 2026-11-25:** commits 0cff2f0d and 260a6e22. Reviews passed, and the build and deploy are clean. The sheet is archived byte-identical and removed. Still open: an in-client check, which needs this ticket's map dialog or monster-event marker on screen.
